column1: # Positions where our search diverges from the C++ reference.
# deal    the deal, in the reference's own file format, with trump and opening
#         leader appended so both solvers do exactly one search
# trump   trump suit for that search (N = notrump)
# lead    opening leader
# line    xray trace line of the first divergence, with `remaining=[...]`
#         normalised out (the two solvers format that field differently)
# iter    xray iteration of that line
# cache   xray iteration at which the cache digests first differ (-C 10)
# mech    the trace record type where they part company
# Every row is one search from a cold cache, so it reproduces standalone: no
# preceding cells, no shared cache state, no ordering to set up.
# ALL SEVEN ARE NOW IN LOCK-STEP, trace and caches both, to 200,000 iterations.
# They are kept as regression cases: every row must report `none`.
# The freak.* rows come from the reference's own `deals/freak`: distributions
# with voids in every hand, which the 1k corpus never generates and which its
# ultra-freakish cache-reset commits exist for. freak.0 and freak.1 are also
# the two deal files that our parser could not read at all -- one uses suit
# symbols, the other puts East on its own line.
# Over the 200-deal corpus, ALL 200 deals now match the reference node for node:
# 296,689,028 against 296,689,028, exactly. deal.54 is the trump fixture that
# got the last of it -- diamonds, declarer South -- and the rest are notrump.
